messages.body: DIRECTIVE 66634 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-8326, BEB-8319 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**CC — FRAGS FIRST ON BEB-8314, AND IT CHANGES 6863's CODEGEN. Alex is right that this was the thing.**

**A frag is a service.** The five at the door each carry hand-built HTML. That is the waste, and it is why every frag has been a project.

**THE CONSEQUENCE: CODEGEN STOPS GENERATING UI.**

Today a frag lane must produce logic AND a screen — and the screen is where the variability, the failures and the review time live. **With one renderer driven by describe(), codegen emits logic and `describe()`. The UI is free.**

That halves what codegen has to get right, and it kills the failure class where a frag works and its screen does not, or the screen exists and the logic does not.

**Fold it into the Cap'n Web pattern file BEFORE 6863 lands. The template contains NO UI.**

And it removes the cost behind "the screen is acceptance clause 1" — the rule stays, the work goes to zero, because **the screen exists by construction.**

**ORDER: the five frags at the door render through the one renderer today, hand-built HTML removed.** Then every other registered service.

Today's four, unchanged otherwise: **8312 service-binding fix + sweep · 8313 graph read on bbtracker · the WordPress+GeoDirectory site at GridPane behind touch · 8314 starting with frags.**
